status: Manually reconstructed from retail instructions and generated CFGs; source claims and strict referents remain pending.

functions.name: IsCDDrive
functions.profile_control: G5 body exact after COFF operand masking; G6 emits arithmetic bool sequence instead of xor/cmp/sete/mov.

functions.name: DriveSupportsFreeSpaceQuery
functions.arguments: char drive letter; GetDiskFreeSpaceExA receives three ULARGE_INTEGER outputs
functions.behavior: SetErrorMode(SEM_FAILCRITICALERRORS), query drive, restore old mode on both exits; true iff query succeeds.

functions.name: SetupCDDrive
functions.profile_control: G5 removes the G6 xor before the byte drive-letter argument and agrees on CFG/block instruction counts. Stack allocation and instruction encoding sizes still differ.

behavior: Open local .\DATA\HEROES.AGG; retry after chdir(gcRegAppPath). Return 3 for failed chdir, 4 for missing AGG.
Enumerate CD-ROM drives C through Z into int32 slots. Retail memset clears only 26 bytes; preserve this quirk.
Accept registered path only if nonempty, first letter A-Z, drive supports free-space query, and concatenated Ogg probe opens.
If no CD-ROM drives remain, return 1. Otherwise two passes, sleeping 3000 ms after each unsuccessful pass.
For each ready CD drive, open drive-letter + colon + probe path, seek last 100 bytes and read them. Return failure only for -1, not for a short read.
On success set gcRegCDRomPath to the drive letter and colon; write HMM1 CDDrive to the Buka 1.000 registry key, and return 0 even if opening the registry key fails.
Return 2 after both unsuccessful passes. No MCI commands or gSoundPath/gAnimPath rewriting remain.
limits: The probe path has no leading backslash, so drive-relative resolution is preserved. Registry preference loading and other startup behavior are not fully migrated.
